verdict.rationale: The Zoho Invoice API docs are served under a versioned path (/api/v3/), so the API is versioned, but versioning is shown only by the URL. Nothing in the pack documents a deprecation policy, sunset timelines, or version-change guarantees. missing for 10: a documented deprecation policy, explicit versioning documentation (version lifecycle, supported versions, changelog), and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: The Zoho Invoice API allows you to perform all the operations that you do with our web client.
Zoho REST APIs uses the OAuth 2.0 protocol to authorize and authenticate calls.
